cover.main: YOUR BRICKELL ROOFTOP IS ABOUT TO TURN INTO

photo.prompt: five invented friends stepping out of a Brickell rooftop elevator at night, skyline glowing behind them, one person holding up a phone with a full group chat, neon blue bar lights, crowded terrace in the background

slides.headline: The View Gets Everyone Quiet
slides.body: Biscayne Bay starts sparkling and suddenly the whole group is acting cinematic.

photo.prompt: an invented group of friends standing at a packed Brickell rooftop railing at night, staring at the glowing Biscayne Bay skyline while blue and pink club lights hit their faces

slides.headline: The Elevator Takes Ten Minutes
slides.body: By floor 42, someone has picked the next spot and someone else has made a new friend.

photo.prompt: invented Miami partygoers laughing inside a crowded luxury Brickell elevator at night, mirrored walls, rooftop wristbands, phone screens glowing, city lights visible through glass

slides.headline: Your Table Becomes A Reunion
slides.body: You knew four people. Now Coral Gables, Doral, and Wynwood are all pulling up.

photo.prompt: a Brickell rooftop lounge table at night with invented friends greeting more invented friends, sparkling city skyline, small plates, mocktails, phones out, warm gold lighting

slides.headline: Someone Mentions A Boat Tomorrow
slides.body: It is 1:12am and somehow everyone is suddenly available for a marina plan.

photo.prompt: invented friends on a Brickell rooftop at 1am pointing at a phone with a boat day plan, Miami River lights below, excited faces, neon blue lighting

slides.headline: You Open NEAR Before Leaving
slides.body: One look and the quick goodbye turns into South Beach, Wynwood, or both.

photo.prompt: an invented woman in a black going out outfit checking a nightlife app on her phone on a Brickell rooftop, friends leaning in behind her, skyline and crowded bar glowing blue
